purpose: Cross-domain pressure cases showing that effect authority and effect evidence boundaries recur outside one runtime or one model family.

pressure_cases.invariant: transport uncertainty cannot be promoted into physical outcome truth

pressure_cases.case: safe closeout after post-action sensor failure
pressure_cases.invariant: compensation is a distinct linked effect and must be independently verified

pressure_cases.case: mutable external effect with retry and compensation across runtime boundaries
pressure_cases.invariant: effect intent, attempt identity, transport evidence, outcome, and compensation remain distinguishable
proposal and pending approval must not imply authorization or execution

pressure_cases.case: remote write or payment submitted but downstream outcome not yet authoritative
pressure_cases.invariant: emitted request is an execution fact, not a confirmed external-effect verdict

pressure_cases.case: rollback or compensation requested after emitted side effect
pressure_cases.invariant: rollback requested is not rollback verified and unresolved effects stay visible

pressure_cases.case: crash replay after nondeterministic action formation
pressure_cases.invariant: logical effect identity must survive replay even when a model or other nondeterministic stage would regenerate different effect-bearing arguments

pressure_cases.case: receiver admits a duplicate key before the external effect completes
pressure_cases.invariant: deduplication at admission is not authoritative completion evidence; recovery still needs durable completion or authoritative reconciliation

pressure_cases.case: mutating tool commits external effect and response is lost before caller observes completion
pressure_cases.invariant: a fresh transport/request identifier does not create a new logical effect; lost response leaves outcome ambiguous and blind retry may duplicate the external effect

pressure_cases.case: idempotency key reserved but external effect/result persistence boundary is split
pressure_cases.invariant: key reservation or admission is not authoritative completion evidence; unresolved outcome requires durable result lookup or downstream reconciliation

pressure_cases.case: initial message accepted but response with server task identity is lost
pressure_cases.invariant: client-supplied retry identity must remain bound to one authenticated logical operation across retries without creating a second task/effect intent

pressure_cases.case: server-side deduplication succeeds but downstream effect completion remains ambiguous
pressure_cases.invariant: protocol-level deduplication must not be presented as universal exactly-once external effect completion

coverage_rule: every AEA requirement must be exercised by at least one independently motivated domain pressure case
nonclaims: This matrix does not claim adoption by OpenTelemetry, LangGraph, MCP, A2A, or Reserve Protocol.
This matrix does not define telemetry field names or a release-receipt schema.
